proof_body:
by
  intro a b c d
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
    have hpq : max a c < min b d := max_lt (lt_min h1 h3) (lt_min h4 h2)
    have hp1 := le_max_left a c
    have hp2 := le_max_right a c
    have hq1 := min_le_left b d
    have hq2 := min_le_right b d
    exact ⟨(max a c + min b d) / 2, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
target_source: ∀ a b c d : ℝ, (∃ x : ℝ, a < x ∧ x < b ∧ c < x ∧ x < d) ↔ (a < b ∧ c < d ∧ a < d ∧ c < b)
